outcome_definition: CALL AGREEMENT, not a mismatch effect: allele-level sensitivity and specificity of an allele-specific RPA assay against IEF/HPLC genotype, reported by the paper as n / d and recomputed here. There is no fold change and no time-to-positive difference to land. n_samples_excluded = 109 enrolled minus 91 genotyped in Table 2; the paper's own denominator for accuracy is 91.
evidence_tier: primary table (Tables 1-2, calls vs reference genotype)
